prompt:
ONE original square 1024x1024 premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of RÅ, the Scandinavian and Sami keeper spirit of the forest, NOT the Egyptian sun god.
ANATOMY: ONE female human-form forest rå, ONE head, TWO eyes, TWO arms, TWO legs; fully opaque dark wool long dress and mantle, no crown, solar disk, horns, wings, extra eyes, hollow back or tail. Weathered stern woman face close to viewer. [ra-c06]
MOMENT: Stride out between forest trunks directly toward viewer with one hand thrust palm-first toward intruder; commanding downward gaze. A powerful wind gust whips her mantle and pushes branches and needles outward around her advancing body.
POWER: Documented mastery of natural forces and animals of her guarded place: physical forest wind bows the branches, rushes needles and bends undergrowth; no emitted rays, no glowing eyes, no floating runes. [ra-c02]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; waist-up close view with huge foreshortened palm and imposing face, figure fills most of square; perspective only, no unsupported giant body size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE low amber sunset shaft from behind trees rims hand and wet cloak, dark walnut-green shadows; flying needles, damp natural mist, no glowing colored haze.
SURFACE: coarse wet wool, weathered skin, pine bark, mud, dense dark needles.
SETTING: a guarded Scandinavian forest, skogsrå type explicitly selected; trees and vegetation visible close behind. [ra-c01,c03]
MOOD: awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate to the documented tradition, imposing and intense, never cute, placid or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; original design, no film/game/anime/comic references; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon outline, magical symbols or energy ribbons.

nonhuman_features.description: Physical wind in forest expresses documented control of natural forces

historical_basis.quote: short for rådare ("ruler") from råda (to rule, to advise) from old Norse ráða, is a spirit who is the keeper or warden of a particular location or landform. The rå is known both in Nordic culture and in the Sami culture, where it is called radie.

statement.id: Rå, kependekan dari rådare ("penguasa"), dari råda ("memerintah, menasihati") dan Nordik Kuno ráða, adalah roh penjaga suatu tempat atau bentang alam, dikenal dalam budaya Nordik maupun Sami, yang menyebutnya radie.
statement.en: Rå, short for rådare ('ruler'), from råda ('to rule, to advise') and Old Norse ráða, is a spirit keeping a particular place or landform, known in both Nordic and Sami culture, where it is called radie.

historical_basis.quote: It was important for humans to cultivate good relationships with them, since they had power over the natural forces and animals under their care, and could cause both good and bad luck for humans who interfered with the places and creatures under their watch.

statement.id: Manusia penting menjaga hubungan baik dengan mereka, karena mereka menguasai kekuatan alam dan hewan di bawah asuhannya dan dapat membawa untung maupun sial bagi orang yang mengganggu tempat dan makhluk yang dijaganya.
statement.en: It was important for people to keep good relations with them, as they ruled the natural forces and animals in their care and could bring good or bad luck to anyone interfering with what they watched over.

historical_basis.quote: The different species of rår are sometimes distinguished according to the different spheres of nature with which each was associated, such as skogsrå or hulder (forest), sjörå (freshwater) or havsrå (saltwater), and bergsrå (mountains).

statement.id: Jenis-jenis rår kadang dibedakan menurut wilayah alam yang dikaitkan dengannya, seperti skogsrå atau hulder (hutan), sjörå (air tawar), havsrå (air asin), dan bergsrå (gunung).
statement.en: The kinds of rår are sometimes told apart by their sphere of nature, such as skogsrå or hulder (forest), sjörå (fresh water), havsrå (salt water) and bergsrå (mountains).

historical_basis.quote: Les rår peuvent apparaître sous forme animale ou sous la forme d'un homme ou d'une femme ; le skogsrå et le bergsrå sont généralement décrits comme féminins.

statement.id: Rår bisa tampil berwujud hewan atau sebagai laki-laki atau perempuan; skogsrå dan bergsrå biasanya digambarkan perempuan.
statement.en: Rår may appear as animals or as a man or woman; the skogsrå and bergsrå are usually described as female.

No horns, antlers, extra wings, fiery eyes, talisman, glowing anatomy, hybrid tails, other animals, people, hunter, weapons, text, border, signature or watermark. This shows one documented forest-rå subtype animal transformation, not the form of all rår.
